verses.text: For the music director. A psalm by David. May the LORD answer you when trouble comes. May the name of the God of Jacob lift you out of danger.
May he send you help from the sanctuary and support you from Zion.
May he remember every offering you’ve brought and accept your burnt sacrifice. Selah.
May he give you what your heart desires and bring all your plans to pass.
We’ll shout for joy when you’re saved and raise our banners in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all you ask.
Now I know the LORD saves his anointed. He’ll answer from his holy heaven with the saving power of his right hand.
Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
They buckle and fall, but we rise and stand firm.
Save us, LORD! May the King answer us when we call!
